Exercise: IT Band and Glute Stretch

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_hip_abduction
- external_rotation

Primary Muscles:

- abductors

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improve_it_band_and_glute_flexibility

Contraindications:

- acute hip or knee injury

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:
None

Instructions:

- Loop a belt, rope, or band around one of your feet, and swing that leg across your body to the opposite side, keeping the leg extended as you lay on the ground. This will be your starting position.
- Keeping your foot off of the floor, pull on the belt, using the tension to pull the toes up. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and repeat on the other side.
